title: Introduce Redis cache for the product catalog
description: Catalog p95 latency exceeds 1.8s under load (see CONV-001). Add a Redis cache in front of PostgreSQL using cache-aside. Initial catalog TTL: 300 seconds.

comments.author: Priya Raman
comments.content: Design agreed in CONV-002: cache-aside with invalidation on write.

resolution: Redis cache deployed to production. Catalog p95 dropped from 1.8s to 240ms. Catalog TTL set to 300 seconds.
